title: Law 2 Probe v2: 32x32 RGB Sprites with ResNet+GroupNorm + ViT Critic (1600 Steps)
intuition: Calibrated 1,600-step v2 Law 2 probe testing differentiation faithfulness on 32x32x3 4-class RGB geometric sprites scored by a compact ResNet+GroupNorm + Patch-4 multi-head attention (ViT) critic.
failure_mode: Forward-mode fwAD breaks or loses gradient fidelity on SDPA attention / GroupNorm layers where exact reverse-over-reverse (RoR) is required, causing blurred sprites or mode imbalance.
protocol_notes: Four Laws Adherence v2 diagnostic probe (1,600 updates, 32x32x3 RGB sprites, 1500s timeout).
